label: Comfort when feeling low
when_to_use: Sad, tired of the day, wants warmth and reassurance rather than more heaviness

label: Sit with the sadness
when_to_use: Grieving, heartbroken or wants a cathartic cry; music that meets the feeling rather than fixing it

label: Calm an anxious mind
when_to_use: Stressed, restless, overthinking; wants to slow down

label: Wind down / sleep
when_to_use: Late night, can't sleep, wants something soothing

label: Joyful / celebrate
when_to_use: Good news, happy day, festive mood

label: Energise / get going
when_to_use: Needs a cheerful push, workout, start of a big task

label: Intense / dramatic
when_to_use: Wants something powerful and stirring that matches strong emotion

label: Devotional / reflective
when_to_use: Prayerful, introspective, wants depth and stillness

label: Grand / uplifted
when_to_use: Wants something majestic and expansive, feeling inspired

label: Fresh morning start
when_to_use: Morning, new beginning, bright and clear

label: Light / playful
when_to_use: Relaxed, casual, wants something easy and charming
